model.name: planar-cr3bp
model.constants_source: mu, lunit, tunit, radius_secondary: NASA/JPL Three-Body Periodic Orbits API (https://ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/periodic_orbits.api?sys=earth-moon&family=lyapunov&libr=1, retrieved 2026-10-18); Earth radius 6371.0 km from the NASA NSSDCA Earth Fact Sheet

period_days.definition: orbit period; time_scale_seconds = 382981.289129055 s, 1 day = 86400 s

jacobi_constant.definition: Jacobi constant of the initial state

initial_x_km.definition: barycentric x of the initial perpendicular x-axis crossing; km via length_scale_km = 389703.264829278 km (jpl_periodic_orbits_catalog)

initial_vy_km_s.definition: rotating-frame vy at the initial state; km/s via velocity_scale_km_s = 1.0175517078536906 km/s (jpl_periodic_orbits_catalog)

x_extent_km.definition: max(x) - min(x) of samples; km via length_scale_km = 389703.264829278 km (jpl_periodic_orbits_catalog)

y_extent_km.definition: max(y) - min(y) of samples; km via length_scale_km = 389703.264829278 km (jpl_periodic_orbits_catalog)

min_earth_distance_km.definition: min Earth-center distance of samples; km via length_scale_km = 389703.264829278 km (jpl_periodic_orbits_catalog)

min_moon_distance_km.definition: min Moon-center distance of samples; km via length_scale_km = 389703.264829278 km (jpl_periodic_orbits_catalog)

sample_step_hours.definition: uniform time step between samples; time_scale_seconds = 382981.289129055 s, 1 day = 86400 s

monodromy_lambda_max.definition: largest eigenvalue modulus of the computed monodromy matrix: growth per period of a perturbation along the unstable direction

limitations: Planar circular restricted three-body model: no lunar eccentricity, out-of-plane motion, solar or other perturbations, or ephemeris effects.

Constants follow the JPL periodic-orbit catalog (length unit 389703.264829278 km, not 384400 km; model.length_scale_convention) so the orbit is directly comparable with the catalog; km, day and km/s values depend on that convention.
Samples are a uniform-time resampling of the DOP853 dense-output interpolant for playback; accepted solver steps are not exported.

The orbit is strongly unstable: the largest monodromy eigenvalue is 1808.9 (catalog stability index (lambda + 1/lambda)/2 = 904.465406637648), so a small error along the unstable direction grows by that factor each period. The trajectory accuracy claim covers the exported single period only; Jacobi drift stays small even after a longer propagation has left the orbit, so it does not certify multi-period trajectories.
'validated' means the recorded numerical checks passed; it is not a new scientific result.

checks.name: periodicity_max_abs_state_error_one_period
checks.definition: max |s(T) - s(0)| over (x, y, vx, vy) after one computed period T

checks.name: jacobi_max_abs_drift_exported_samples
checks.definition: max |C(s_i) - C(s_0)| over the exported samples

checks.name: jacobi_max_abs_drift_3_periods
checks.definition: max |C(t) - C(0)| at 3001 uniform times over 3 periods; a conservation check only: it does not detect departure from the unstable orbit

checks.name: tight_tolerance_max_abs_state_difference_samples
checks.definition: max |s - s_ref| over (x, y, vx, vy) at the exported sample times; s_ref: DOP853 rtol = atol = 1e-13

checks.name: independent_integrator_max_abs_state_difference_samples
checks.definition: max |s - s_ref| over (x, y, vx, vy) at the exported sample times; s_ref: LSODA rtol = atol = 1e-13

checks.name: jpl_catalog_abs_diff_vy0
checks.definition: |vy0 - vy0_catalog| against the JPL catalog entry in validation.reference; vy0 is computed without catalog velocities

checks.name: jpl_catalog_abs_diff_period
checks.definition: |T - T_catalog| against the JPL catalog entry in validation.reference

checks.name: jpl_catalog_abs_diff_jacobi
checks.definition: |C(s0) - C_catalog| against the JPL catalog entry in validation.reference. Not independent of jpl_catalog_abs_diff_vy0: x0 equals the catalog value and y0 = vx0 = 0, so the difference is |2 vy0 dvy0 + dvy0^2| up to the catalog's rounding of C; it checks only the Jacobi-constant convention

checks.name: jpl_catalog_rel_diff_stability_index
checks.definition: |nu - nu_catalog| / nu_catalog with nu = (lambda_max + 1/lambda_max)/2 from the computed monodromy matrix (DOP853 rtol = atol = 1e-13)

checks.name: non_horizon_terminations_or_collision_events
checks.definition: collision events plus non-horizon terminations over the exported, tight, independent-integrator and multi-period propagations

checks.name: non_finite_sample_values
checks.definition: count of non-finite values in trajectory samples

checks.name: non_increasing_sample_times
checks.definition: count of consecutive sample times with t[i+1] <= t[i]
